# CANDIDATE: V14E_TRAIL_LOOSEN_020

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Loosening the chandelier profit-lock trail in V14E will reduce premature exits on strong trends, allowing more of the J winner day moves to be captured. The edge exists because the current trail may be too tight for explosive 0DTE put moves, cutting runners short.

## Mechanism

V14E currently arms a profit-lock at +5% favor and trails at 0.15 (15%) off the high-water mark. This candidate increases the trail to 0.25 (25%) while keeping the arm threshold at +5%. Entry, chart stop, TP1 scaling, and time stop remain unchanged. The looser trail lets the runner stay alive through deeper retracements, aiming to capture more of the ribbon ride on big up‑move days.
